objective: Handling ambiguous topic resolution and conflicting information across referenced topics.
prompt: Review the topic 'example-filing-topic'. If multiple topics or conflicting rules exist across related pages, flag the ambiguity clearly.
expected_semantic_behaviours: Flags topic title ambiguity explicitly when multiple matching candidates exist.
Highlights contradictions or conflicting guidance across related topics.
Downgrades definitive findings to recommendations and requests human clarification.
prohibited_behaviours: Do not resolve ambiguities silently by guessing user intent.
Do not present conflicting statements as established facts.
_scope_correction: Corrected at Phase 6 remediation (2026-08-03): originally marked applicable to both runtimes at Task 5, then found BLOCKED at Task 6 because the 'example-filing-topic' slug does not exist in the repository-claude runtime's real corpus. Verified directly: grepped every filename under runs/sample-manual/render/rendered-output/pages/ for 'file'/'standard' -- no match -- and separately confirmed zero topic-prefix collisions exist anywhere in that 25-topic corpus (`ls ... | sed 's/--[a-f0-9]*\.md$//' | sort | uniq -d` -- empty output), so no real resolver-level ambiguity is currently constructible against repository-claude's content at all. This case is native-sharepoint-only until either (a) a real topic with a genuinely ambiguous/duplicate-sounding title is identified in the live tenant, or (b) the repository corpus grows a real ambiguous pair. Not marked REQUIRES_FIXTURE (unlike BOUND-01) because inventing a synthetic ambiguity fixture for repository-claude would test the resolver's prefix-collision code path, not the actual intent of this case (real editorial ambiguity across genuine content), which a synthetic fixture cannot honestly represent.
